name: How often should gas pipes be inspected?

mainEntity.name: How often should gas pipes be inspected?

acceptedAnswer.text: While there isn't a universally mandated inspection frequency for residential gas pipes, it's generally recommended to have your gas lines inspected every 3-5 years, especially if your home is older. Regular inspections can help identify potential issues like corrosion, wear, or minor leaks before they become major problems. If you experience any symptoms of a leak, an immediate inspection is necessary. Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC can perform these safety checks.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's recommended to have gas pipes inspected every 3-5 years, or immediately if you suspect a leak.
